Súkromie · Slovíčko

Privacy policy

Effective 17 November 2026

In short: Slovíčko collects nothing. There’s no account, no ads, no analytics and no tracking, and the app never sends us anything. Your progress stays on your phone, and you can delete it at any time. The optional one-time purchase goes through Apple’s App Store or Google Play: Apple or Google take the payment, and we never see your payment details.

Who this policy is from

This policy is from the developer of Slovíčko (“we”). It explains what happens to your information when you use the Slovíčko app on iPhone or Android.

What we collect

Nothing. Slovíčko has no account and no servers, and it contains no analytics, advertising or tracking code. Lessons, stories, games and voices all work offline, and the app never sends your progress or your choices anywhere, so we never see who you are, what you learn or how you use it.

The one thing that involves the internet is the optional one-time purchase and its price. Apple’s App Store or Google Play handles those, as explained under “The optional one-time purchase” below, and the app sends us nothing about it.

We don’t sell or share information about you, because we never have any.

What stays on your phone

So you can carry on where you left off, the app saves a few things in its own storage on your phone:

  • the first name you can give Róza so she can greet you — optional, you can leave it empty
  • your learning progress: XP and level, your streak and the days you practised, finished lessons and stars, the words you’ve met and how well you know them, achievements, passport stamps, starred words and game scores
  • your choices: your daily goal, why you’re learning, Róza’s outfit, your voice and the app’s settings, including the time of your daily reminder
  • whether you’ve unlocked the full trip and since when, and whether Róza has already told you about it — no payment details, which the app never has

This information is used only inside the app, to show your progress and remember your choices. Slovíčko never sends it anywhere.

The optional one-time purchase

Slovíčko is free to download, and the first stops of the trip are free for good. The rest of the trip comes with an optional one-time purchase. It isn’t a subscription and nothing renews.

The purchase is made with Apple’s App Store on iPhone or Google Play on Android, using the Apple Account or Google Account on your phone. Apple or Google take the payment and send your receipt, under their own terms and privacy policies. Slovíčko never sees your card or other payment details, and neither do we. For a receipt or a refund, ask Apple or Google. On Android we can also refund a purchase ourselves through Google Play if you write to us with its order number.

To show the price in your own currency and to know whether the full trip is unlocked, the app asks the App Store or Google Play on your phone, for example when the app starts, when you open the unlock screen and when you tap Restore purchase. The store may check with Apple’s or Google’s servers to answer. On Android, the app does this through the Google Play Billing Library, a part Google provides for apps that sell through Google Play. According to Google, this library records whether its requests succeed or fail and any connection problems, and Google uses that to improve the library and to help with errors. Google handles that information under its own privacy policy; it doesn’t reach us.

Once the trip is unlocked, the app remembers that in its own storage on your phone, so it stays unlocked offline. Resetting your progress keeps it. If you delete the app or move to a new phone, the app finds the purchase again through the same Apple Account or Google Account, or you can tap Restore purchase in Settings.

Apple and Google give app developers sales reports, such as how many purchases were made, when and in which country. These reports never include your card or bank details.

How long it’s kept, and how to delete it

Everything stays on your phone until you delete it. In Settings, under Tvoje údaje · Your data, you can:

  • Reset learning progress — erases your progress and keeps your name, daily goal and settings.
  • Start over completely — erases everything Slovíčko has saved, including your name, apart from the full-trip unlock.

Neither one takes away the full-trip unlock if you bought it: that’s a purchase, not progress.

Deleting the app also deletes everything it saved, the unlock included; the purchase itself stays with your Apple Account or Google Account, and Restore purchase in Settings brings it back.

If your phone makes backups (for example to iCloud or to your Google account), a backup may include Slovíčko’s saved data. Backups are handled by Apple or Google under your own backup settings, and we can’t see them.

Daily reminders

The daily reminder is optional. If you turn it on, the app asks your phone for permission to show notifications and schedules the reminders on the phone itself. No server is involved and nothing is sent anywhere. You can turn the reminder off in Settings, or turn off Slovíčko’s notifications in your phone’s settings.

Voices and speaking

The Slovak voices that come with the app are computer-generated: they were made in advance with the openly licensed Supertonic 3 speech model and are stored inside the app. They are not recordings of real people.

Slovíčko never uses your microphone and never records you. In speaking exercises you say a word out loud and tell Róza yourself how it went.

If you choose your phone’s own voice instead, the Slovak text to be read aloud is passed to your phone’s built-in text-to-speech, which is part of your phone’s system and covered by its maker’s privacy terms.

The App Store and Google Play

You download Slovíčko from Apple’s App Store or from Google Play, and they handle that under their own privacy policies. They may give app developers combined, anonymous statistics, such as the number of downloads, and crash reports if you have agreed in your phone’s settings to share them with developers. These don’t tell us who you are.

Links to websites

If you tap a link in the app — to a project’s page on the Credits screen, for example — it opens in your web browser, which has its own privacy terms.

Children

Slovíčko is not directed at children under 13. Because the app collects no personal information from anyone, it collects none from children either.

Changes to this policy

If this policy changes, the new version will be in the app (Settings → O aplikácii · About → Privacy policy) and on its web page, with a new effective date at the top. If a future version of the app ever needed to handle your information differently, we would update this policy before releasing it.

Contact

Questions about this policy or your data? Write to us at the address on Slovíčko’s help page, linked below and from Slovíčko’s page in the App Store and on Google Play.

If you write to us, we receive your email address and whatever you send, and we use them only to answer you. We don’t add you to any list, and we delete your messages if you ask us to.
